config._note: comp-cycles (2026-07-15): the round-container half of the compensation-review MVP (ADR-001 Rule 6 sub-page under the existing Personeel menu, the ReviewCycleDetail precedent). The 'Cyclus' data widget carries every field (name/period/effectiveDate/status/description — no $ref to exclude). The 'Voorstellen in deze cyclus' object-list (CompAdjustment.cycleId = @objectId) is the round's in-progress roster, rowRoute to CompAdjustmentDetail. lifecycleActions expose exactly sluiten (open->closed, hr-comp.json) -- no reopen edge, a closed cycle is history (the ReviewCycle/Objective no-resurrection precedent); approval/effectuation lives per-adjustment, not here. The 'Aanpassing voorstellen' open-form action opens a plain CompAdjustment create form -- verified: this manifest version has no declarative field-prefill primitive (no existing open-form action in the codebase carries default field values), so cycleId is entered on the created form rather than auto-seeded, a deliberate scope-down from design.md's aspirational 'scoped to the cycle' prose. Audit history is a sidebar tab.

params.title: Salary band
params.note: comp-cycles (2026-07-15): read-only internal salary-band reference detail (the CaoDetail allowCreate:false shape). The 'Salarisschaal' data widget carries every field (bandId/title/grade/minSalary/referenceSalary/maxSalary/currency/cao/caoSchaal/effectiveFrom/active) — no Related widget, since cao/caoSchaal are plain string links into the CAO corpus (mirroring EmploymentContract.cao), not $ref relations. No lifecycleActions (SalaryBand has no x-openregister-lifecycle). No create/edit affordances — bands are authored reference data. Audit history is a sidebar tab.

params.title: Compensation adjustment
params.note: comp-cycles (2026-07-15): the per-employee proposal half of the compensation-review MVP (ADR-001 Rule 6 — reached from EmployeeDetail's emp-comp-adjustments row, the cycle's adjustment list, or the deepLink; deliberately NOT a menu child, the PerformanceReviewDetail/TimesheetDetail convention). The 'Aanpassing' data widget carries currentSalary/proposedSalary/effectiveDate/status/rationale/proposedBy/approvedBy/appliedAt, excluding cycleId/employeeId/contractId/targetBandId (Related resolves and links all four by name). lifecycleActions expose ONLY propose/approve/reject (hr-comp.json) — approve/reject are guarded server-side by the reused NoSelfApprovalGuard (the proposer may not approve/reject their own proposal). effectuate is deliberately NOT exposed as a plain lifecycleActions button: D5/D7 gate the write (within-band + the Employee.grossMonthlySalary stamp) inside CompAdjustmentService, and CompEffectiveDateGuard alone is read-only, so a bare declarative transition would flip status to effective without ever writing the salary (the orphaned-capability trap) — the ONLY effectuate path is the guarded 'Effectueren' api-call action (POST /api/comp/effectuate, CompController::effectuate, the PayrollRunDetail '(Her)berekenen' precedent). Audit history is a sidebar tab.
